name: Parchment of Fellowship
effect: A parchment inscribed with teachings on the bonds between adventurers and their alter egos. Those who possess it may call forth alter egos capable of employing support jobs.

name: Warrior's Tome
effect: A tome detailing the ways of the warrior. Its teachings may be imparted to alter egos, allowing them to employ WAR as a support job.

name: Ninja's Tome
effect: A tome detailing the ways of the ninja. Its teachings may be imparted to alter egos, allowing them to employ NIN as a support job.

name: Samurai's Tome
effect: A tome detailing the ways of the samurai. Its teachings may be imparted to alter egos, allowing them to employ SAM as a support job.

name: Red Mage's Tome
effect: A tome detailing the ways of the red mage. Its teachings may be imparted to alter egos, allowing them to employ RDM as a support job.

name: Zilart Writ
effect: A writ bearing the seal of the Feritory. Its bearer is granted access to the Feritory Exchange while traveling the lands of Zilart.

name: Promathia Writ
effect: A writ bearing the seal of the Feritory. Its bearer is granted access to the Feritory Exchange while traveling the lands of Promathia.

name: Aht Urhgan Writ
effect: A writ bearing the seal of the Feritory. Its bearer is granted access to the Feritory Exchange while traveling the lands of Aht Urhgan.

name: Goddess Writ
effect: A writ bearing the seal of the Feritory. Its bearer is granted access to the Feritory Exchange while traveling the lands touched by the Crystal War.
